In detail

Ludwigsvorstadt-Isarvorstadt is one of Munich's 25 official Stadtbezirke (city districts). Polizeipraesidium Muenchen and the Statistisches Amt Muenchen recorded 9,852 total offences here in 2025, across a population of 50,081 residents (31 December 2024) — a rate of 19,672 offences per 100,000 residents, roughly 4.0x the citywide Stadtbezirk average. This rate is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy central, station, or nightlife-heavy district can read higher without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential district can show a low rate simply by having few offences relative to its population. This district includes the area around Munich Hauptbahnhof (the main train station) and the Gaertnerplatz/Glockenbach nightlife district — both draw far more people through them than the district's resident count alone would suggest, which pushes its per-resident rate up without that meaning elevated risk per visit. This is Wandroz's official-data layer for Munich — real Polizeipraesidium Muenchen / Statistisches Amt Muenchen figures, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data is not split here by time of day, so both figures shown here are the same.
